system.description:
ARCANE FOCUS RYUKARI SAVE TECHNIQUE

The elemental current carried within your blood can no longer be contained. With a violent exhalation, you release a fragment of the breath once wielded by your draconic ancestors.

Prerequisites Level 5

Action 2 AP; Area 15-foot cone

Saving Throw Basic Reflex against your Level DC

You exhale elemental energy, inflicting 1d6 damage per 2-character levels, with a minimum of 2d6.

The damage type and additional traits are determined by your heritage:

HeritageDamageAdditional Traits
ShinryuElectricityAir, Electricity
ZennyoColdCold, Water
FukuAcidAcid, Earth
KuraColdCold, Shadow
ZenkiFireFire

Automated: target the creatures in your 15-foot cone, then press Use: 2 AP and its Focus use. A basic Reflex save against your Level DC; 1d6 per two levels (at least 2d6) of your heritage's type — Shinryu electricity, Zennyo and Kura cold, Fuku acid, Zenki fire — with its traits.
